_instructions: Model Intelligence DB seed — covers the WHOLE model universe, independent of
the DAON Model Registry. Registry = what DAON can call today; this DB = what
the world knows about every model. New Registry entries look up here first.
Research protocol (2026-08 sweep, verified 2026-08-23): official vendor sources only:
1. Vendor's own publication (HF model card, official blog/docs/product page)
2. Another vendor's official publication quoting the score (cross-vendor tables)
3. Archived copy of the vendor's own page (Wayback snapshot) when the live page
blocks bots — flagged in the source URL and entry note.
SPA pages (qwen.ai) were rendered with a real browser (Playwright); raw HTML fetch
shows an empty shell there. Scores without a reachable official source stay null.
Every filled benchmark MUST carry source (URL) and as_of (YYYY-MM of verification).
'note' is free-form provenance detail (benchmark version, harness); the loader
ignores it but humans reading this file need it.
Benchmark-name normalization to the loader's capability map keys:
- SWE-bench Verified / SWE-bench Pro / Terminal-Bench / LiveCodeBench / GPQA /
AIME / Long context are mapped keys; version detail goes into 'note'.
- MMLU-Pro, MRCR variants, HLE, OSWorld, DeepSWE, BrowseComp, MCP-*, FrontierMath,
Toolathlon, AutomationBench etc. have NO map key -> kept verbatim (evidence line
only, they do not feed a capability axis).
- Elo/composite indices (GDPval, AA Intelligence Index, Code Arena) are omitted:
not 0..100 accuracy scales.
Runtime overrides live in ~/.hermes/model_intel.json (same schema, entries there win).
Lineage rule: a NEW model version gets a FRESH entry with parent=<previous version>.
Never copy DAON stats across versions - ModelHistory is keyed by model_id so this is automatic.
